description:
Stop with the saved findings. status is the scientific disposition; disposition is
delivery as declared by WriteDeliveryControl.

disposition.description: Write delivery status, not scientific completeness: COMPLETE when no rejected write is left unresolved. Choose disposition PARTIAL to stop with unresolved writes; the host records them in the delivery without marking them repaired.

explanation.description: Your reason for this scientific status.

status.description: Scientific search status for the assigned scope: COMPLETE when paragraph ownership and boundaries are settled and relevant continuations or referenced methods have been handled. Completeness concerns relevant scientific content and its attribution, not collecting every form of material. A separate title, caption or repeated account is needed only when it resolves a concrete gap in that content, attribution or passage boundary. In a step task, other steps' unread material does not prevent COMPLETE; document coverage may honestly remain PARTIAL. Unanswered candidates or unresolved relevant passages require PARTIAL. NO_ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION means the assigned search is complete with no additional paragraphs. An empty candidate list alone does not establish ownership or completion. Delivery disposition is separate.
